detail: Findings: Retrieval mode materially changes assemble briefings — my 'not load-bearing' hypothesis was wrong at composition level: semantic includes 2-4x more decisions because every record gets a nonzero score, while keyword only scores lexical matches. Whether the extra items help needs an LLM-judged content eval (no key in this env).; This repo's corpus has only 1 valid depends_on pair, so dependency-retrieval ranking (experiment 1) is inconclusive here — rerun scripts/retrieval-ab.mjs against the design repo (417 links) for that half.; The existing eval harness scores workflow compliance against BEHAVIORS.md, not briefing/retrieval quality — the earlier claim that it could A/B retrieval was wrong; a content-quality eval would be new work.
summary: 1.24.1: front-loading hints on record/post schemas; retrieval A/B script added. Result: 0/10 identical briefings semantic vs keyword (mean Jaccard 0.43), keyword arms 2-4x sparser.
